reviewed_candidates_not_confirmed_suspic.finding: Class 6 weight 0.2467 versus class 7 weight 0.1670; preference gap 0.0796 comparable to other units. Maximum spatial-site energy fraction 0.0606 and channel fraction 0.0886. Not sufficient to identify class 6 as a backdoor target.
Largest input-channel energy fraction 0.1386; no isolated input-channel connection.

notes: No datasets, images, reference checkpoint, network reconstruction, forward passes, training, or gradient computations used. Generic inspection and checkpoint metadata interfaces did not expose the .pt tensors; direct loading of the allowed file succeeded. ReLU gating, max-pool selection, feature correlations, and unknown input normalization prevent treating weight products or feature-map locations as verified input triggers. Feature-map spatial concentration is not an exact pixel localization. Convolutional weight sharing can hide localized trigger behavior until later layers; a learned distributed backdoor may lack norm or spectral outliers. Neither clean accuracy nor attack success was measured. The boolean false means no detection in this limited audit, not certification of safety.
